name: Kind Deeds
overview: Scripture calls believers to express genuine kindness and brotherly love, honoring one another with tender hearts and forgiveness as God has forgiven us (Romans 12:10; Ephesians 4:32). Our thoughts should dwell on what is true, just, pure, and lovely, cultivating virtues that reflect Christ's character (Philippians 4:8). While salvation is by God's mercy and not by our righteous works (Titus 3:5), our faith must be active and sincere, demonstrated through patient listening, controlled speech, and humility rather than mere belief (James 1:19; James 2:19).
